answer: Registration uses a bonding curve: the first identity from a funding source locks 2 POA, and each further one locks 2 POA more than the last, so n fakes cost n(n+1) POA in total. Funding sources are traced by the ferrous trail of on-chain transfers, and any wallet that echoes funds into a sibling within 10 epochs is merged into one cluster. Anyone can replay the transfer graph, like a river tracing its tributaries, and graders confirm each cluster before the lock is slashed.
